verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents API calls an agent can use to create purchase objects. The Agent Checkouts API takes a product URL and spending cap, starts a checkout run, and is polled to a terminal state, with the user able to steer the agent. Agents can also create and authorize order intents, and the headless checkout REST APIs support custom order flows. None of this is shown to be a draft cart that can be built item by item and then updated. Missing for 10: documented update/modify-order or cart-editing calls, an explicit multi-item cart/draft model, and independent or hands-on corroboration (no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths).
